_summary: Structure and build hygiene are clean. Pre-flight passes 20/20. C29, C42, C43, C56, C71, the Excel open check and validate_contract pass. C44 passes through the crosswalk (20/20 filings). C46 passes period-aware: 1,461 tags, 0 mismatches, 0 missing keys, and the only 2027 values sit in labelled 2027 contexts. All worked examples recompute: 941, 940, NV MBT, OR transit, MCTMT (line 2a band read from the line 1a zone payroll, confirmed in MTA-305-I), Seattle, NJ/PA base weeks, CA SDI, NM/OR WC. EFW2 positions were sampled against Pub. 42-007. The verdict is FAIL on F44: 37 of 591 consumed fact instances could not be re-verified against the local copy of their register row, including a wrong register row for MO new-hire 20 days and four 'no return' facts cited to UI pages. Two major build findings: 7 percentages hidden by the DERIVED exemption, and 33 one-sentence Field Explanations (F5). One major register finding: consumed_by is under-filled on 25 rows.
_ruling_derived_rule: PARTIALLY ACCEPTED. The DERIVED exemption is valid for integer positions, lengths, line numbers and code values in rows rendered from a tagged layout, line-map or code-list fact whose register id appears in the same row (31 of 38 hits: SSA-001 File Structure and Field Options, DOR-002 RS). It is NOT valid for percentages or money amounts (7 hits in IRS-003 and IRS-004: 0.9%, 2.9%, 1.2%). These are fact values and must be tagged. Condition for keeping the rule: integer, no '%', no decimal part, and the exempted count reported. Finding 5.
